issues.title: Return or refund refused
issues.description: Read the conditions for online returns and the rules for accepted refunds.
issues.question: When must a marketplace seller accept a return or refund under Rule 6(3)?
issues.preparation: Useful records to keep: the order confirmation, the return request, and the seller's reply. This is a practical suggestion, not an official filing checklist.

issues.title: Unsafe or defective product
issues.description: Separate recall powers from compensation claims and their exceptions.
issues.question: What conditions apply to a manufacturer's product liability under section 84?
issues.preparation: Useful records to keep: purchase details, the product label, photos and any report of injury or damage. Avoid posting personal or medical documents in the question box.

issues.title: Misleading advertisement
issues.description: Check the definition, advertisement safeguards and the Authority's powers.
issues.question: What can the Central Authority do about misleading advertisements under section 21?
issues.preparation: Useful records to keep: a copy of the advertisement, its URL and date, and the terms shown when you bought the product. These records do not by themselves establish a legal violation.

issues.title: Hidden charges or unwanted additions
issues.description: Compare drip pricing, basket sneaking and consent requirements.
issues.question: What is drip pricing and how does it differ from basket sneaking?
issues.preparation: Useful records to keep: screenshots of the first price, checkout and payment confirmation, including any selected extras. This is not a finding that every additional fee is unlawful.

issues.title: Seller details or complaint response
issues.description: Find the seller-information and grievance-handling provisions.
issues.question: After purchase, what seller details must a marketplace provide on a written request under Rule 5(3)(a)?
issues.preparation: Useful records to keep: the listing, invoice, written request and complaint acknowledgement. Contact methods and response duties depend on which entity you are dealing with.

issues.title: Where and how to complain
issues.description: Read the filing provision, ordinary value limits and complaint time limit.
issues.question: What are the District, State and National Commission value limits under the Jurisdiction Rules, 2021?
issues.preparation: NCH asks for grievance details and relevant documents. Formal Commission filing has its own requirements; use the current e-Jagriti manuals. This app does not submit a complaint or select a forum for you.
